translations.idiomatic: The emperor again decreed that he would take the field in person, requisitioned the horses of court officials, and organized capital militia training.

sentences.zh: 鎮西節度馬璘遇吐蕃遊奕四百余人於武功東原，使五十人擊而盡殺之，無噍類。

translations.literal: Frontier military commissioner Ma Lin met more than four hundred Tubo patrol horsemen on the eastern plain of Wugong; he sent fifty men to strike and killed them all; not a mouthful remained.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Lin met more than four hundred Tubo scouts on the eastern plain of Wugong and sent fifty men against them; they killed every man, leaving none alive.

sentences.zh: 自十七日至二十五日晚際始止，議者以為天助。

translations.literal: From the seventeenth to the twenty-fifth it only ceased at evening twilight; discussers thought it heaven's aid.
translations.idiomatic: From the seventeenth through the twenty-fifth fierce gales blew without pause until dusk each day; court opinion called it heaven's aid.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃移營於醴泉縣九飗山北，因攻掠醴泉。

translations.literal: Tubo moved camp north of Jiufeng Mountain in Liquan county and thereupon raided Liquan.
translations.idiomatic: Tubo shifted camp north of Jiufeng Mountain in Liquan county and plundered Liquan.

sentences.zh: 京城大駭，人皆空室，大戶鑿竇以出。

translations.literal: The capital was greatly terrified; people all emptied their rooms; great households bored holes to get out.
translations.idiomatic: Panic seized the capital. Families abandoned their houses, and wealthy households even broke through their walls to flee.

sentences.zh: 逆黨任敷以兵五千余人犯白水縣。

translations.literal: The rebel partisan Ren Fu with more than five thousand troops invaded Baishui county.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel Ren Fu led more than five thousand men against Baishui county.

sentences.zh: 渾日進露布而至，屯於奉天馬嵬店。

translations.literal: Hun Rijin arrived with a victory bulletin and encamped at Mawei post in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Hun Rijin arrived with a victory bulletin and encamped at the Mawei post in Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 今月十九日已後至二十五日已前，交戰二百余陣，破吐蕃一萬余眾，斬首五千級，生擒一百六十人，馬一千二百四十二匹，駝一百一十五頭，器械、幡旗共三萬余事。

translations.literal: From the nineteenth after of this month to before the twenty-fifth, they joined battle in more than two hundred engagements, broke more than ten thousand Tubo masses, beheaded five thousand heads, captured alive one hundred sixty men, horses one thousand two hundred forty-two, camels one hundred fifteen, weapons and banners and flags together more than thirty thousand items.
translations.idiomatic: From the nineteenth through the twenty-fifth of that month they fought more than two hundred engagements, routed over ten thousand Tubo troops, took five thousand heads and one hundred sixty prisoners, and captured one thousand two hundred forty-two horses, one hundred fifteen camels, and more than thirty thousand weapons, banners, and flags.

sentences.zh: 朝官震懼，家口回避者十室八九，禁之不止。

translations.literal: Court officials were shaken with fear; families avoiding relocation were eight or nine in ten houses; prohibiting it did not stop them.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were terrified; eight or nine households in ten sent their families away despite orders forbidding flight.

sentences.zh: 自前年吐蕃犯王畿後，於中渭橋鄠豐城以營兵，至是功畢。

translations.literal: From the year before last when Tubo invaded the royal domain, they had garrisoned troops at the Central Wei Bridge and Efengcheng; by now the work was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Since Tubo's invasion of the capital region two years earlier, garrisons had been built at the Central Wei Bridge and Efengcheng; that work was now finished.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃退至永壽北，遇回紇之眾，雖聞懷恩死，皆悖其眾，相誘而奔，復來寇。

translations.literal: Tubo retreated to north of Yongshou, met Uyghur masses; although they heard Huai'en was dead, all were rebellious toward their masses, enticing one another to flee, and again came to raid.
translations.idiomatic: Tubo withdrew north of Yongshou and met Uyghur forces. Though they had heard Huai'en was dead, the allies distrusted one another, drew one another on in flight, and turned back to raid again.

sentences.zh: 至奉天，兩蕃猜貳爭長，別為營壘。

translations.literal: Reaching Fengtian, the two barbarian groups were suspicious and divided, contending for precedence, each making separate camps and ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: At Fengtian the two allies grew suspicious and quarreled over precedence, each pitching a separate camp.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃遊奕至窯底，吐蕃又至馬嵬店，因縱火焚居人廬舍而退。

translations.literal: Tubo patrol reached Yaodi; Tubo again reached Mawei post; thereupon they set fires burning the common people's houses and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Tubo scouts reached Yaodi, others reached the Mawei post, set fire to civilian dwellings, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 回紇三千騎詣涇陽降款，請擊吐蕃為效，子儀許之。

translations.literal: Three thousand Uyghur horsemen came to Jingyang to offer submission, requesting to strike Tubo in service; Ziyi assented.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand Uyghur horsemen came to Jingyang to submit and offered to fight Tubo on Tang's behalf; Guo Ziyi agreed.

sentences.zh: 於是朔方先鋒兵馬使開府南陽郡王白元光與回紇合於涇陽靈臺縣東五十里，攻破吐蕃。

translations.literal: Thereupon Shuofang vanguard army-and-horse commissioner, acting Grandee of the Palace, Prince of Nanyang commandery Bai Yuanguang joined Uyghur at fifty li east of Lingtai county in Jingyang and broke Tubo.
translations.idiomatic: Then the Shuofang vanguard commissioner Bai Yuanguang, Prince of Nanyang, joined the Uyghurs fifty li east of Lingtai in Jingyang and routed the Tubo army.

sentences.zh: 斬首及生擒獲駝馬牛羊甚眾。

translations.literal: Heads beheaded and captured alive, camels, horses, cattle, and sheep obtained were very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: They took a great toll in heads and prisoners and seized vast numbers of camels, horses, cattle, and sheep.

sentences.zh: 上停親征，京師解嚴，宰相上表稱賀。

translations.literal: The emperor halted the personal campaign; the capital lifted strict guard; chancellors submitted memorials offering congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor canceled his planned campaign in person, the capital stood down from alert, and the chancellors submitted congratulatory memorials.
